title: 第150章 广告之后更精彩
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【小鹿千万别进去啊，里面都是坏人！】

【完了！这里面一共有三个内奸，小鹿这是要自投罗网了！】

【我的小鹿啊，你怎么还是这么傻乎乎的，这三个人都是坏蛋啊，不要相信他们啊混蛋！】

当鹿寒把手背在身后，对走廊深处的迪丽热八做了那个“别过来”的暗号，然后选择相信他们走进房间时。

弹幕里一片哀嚎。

【小鹿啊小鹿！你都察觉不对了，干嘛还要进去啊！】

【傻狍子还是傻狍子，这不是送上门了吗！】

【完了，全完了！】

当陈鹤在鹿寒转头看于和韦的那一瞬间，从他背后撕下名牌时，弹幕彻底炸了。

【鹤哥你太无情太冷漠太绝情！】

【这下真完了，结束了，一切都结束了！】

【鹿寒：我防住了朝哥却没防住鹤哥，甚至还有个辰哥！】

【这三个骗子把我们家傻狍子骗得团团转！】

很快画面来到朝辰鹤三人找到于和韦的房间。

于和韦身着一袭黑色蟒袍端坐在棋案后面。

邓朝自告奋勇要下棋。

【学霸人设还在崩塌中！】

【门口大爷要气死了，他是这么下棋的吗？】

【辰哥的表情就是我现在的表情！】

随后陈鹤接手后稳扎稳打，最后双炮将军拿下棋局。

【果然天才大脑不是白叫的！】

【天才是真天才，学霸是假学霸，天霸要崩了！】

【鹤哥认真起来真能赢啊，太厉害了！】

而当工作人员无情宣布，因为输了一局所以四个人必须戴上铃铛的时候。

邓朝、陈鹤、李辰三人同时沉默的画面让观众笑得停不下来。

【节目组太赖皮了，这不早说的！】

【这是朝哥的锅，必须背！】

【这四个人集体变身铃铛人，走到哪响到哪，比刚才的菠菜贱卖还狠啊。】

然后李辰开口：“戴上铃铛，我们可就是铃铛人了，4V8不是随随便便赢！”

弹幕瞬间被点燃！

大黑牛就是莽！

一个字，干！

随着朝辰鹤三人组的暴露。

Baby通过憋笑挑战问出神秘嘉宾是于和韦。

破解“旭日东升”和“秦始皇”两条线索。

推测出了可能有第三方，也就是秦国的时候。

观众们是无比的震惊。

Baby姐你开挂了？

你也有上帝视角？

content_en:
Page (1/3)

[Little deer, please don’t go in, there are bad people inside!】

【It’s over!There are three traitors here, and Xiaolu is about to throw himself into a trap!】

[My little deer, why are you still so stupid? These three people are all bad guys, don’t believe them, bastard!】

When Lu Han put his hands behind his back, gave the "don't come" signal to Di Lieba deep in the corridor, and then chose to believe that they walked into the room.

There was a cry in the barrage.

【Little deer, little deer!You've realized something is wrong, so why go in?】

[Silly Roe Deer is still Silly Roe Deer, isn’t this delivered to your door!】

[It’s over, it’s all over!】

When Chen He tore off the nametag from Lu Han's back the moment he turned to look at Yu Hewei, the barrage exploded.

[Brother He, you are too ruthless, cold and heartless!】

[It’s really over now, it’s over, everything is over!】

[Lu Han: I guarded against Brother Chao but not Brother He, and there was even Brother Chen!】

[These three swindlers deceived our silly roe deer!】

Soon the scene came to the room where Chao Chenhe and the others found Yu and Wei.

Yu and Wei were wearing black python robes and sitting behind the chess table.

Deng Chao volunteered to play chess.

[The character of the academic master is still crumbling!】

[The man at the door is going to be so angry. Is this how he plays chess?】

[Brother Chen’s expression is my current expression!】

Then Chen He took over and played steadily, and finally the double-gun general won the game.

[Sure enough, the genius brain is not called for nothing!】

[Geniuses are real geniuses, academic masters are fake academic masters, Tianba is about to collapse!】

[Brother He can really win if he takes it seriously, that’s amazing!】

And when the staff ruthlessly announced that four people must wear bells because they lost a round.

The scene where Deng Chao, Chen He and Li Chen were silent at the same time made the audience unable to stop laughing.

[The program team is so shameless, I didn’t tell you this earlier!】

[This is Brother Chao’s fault and must be shouldered!】

[These four people collectively transformed into bell men, ringing the bells wherever they went. It was even worse than the spinach sale just now.】

Then Li Chen said: "Wear the bell, we are the bell people, 4V8 does not win casually!"

The barrage was instantly ignited!

The big black bull is reckless!

One word, do it!

With the exposure of Chao Chenhe's trio.

Baby used the laugh challenge to find out who the mysterious guests were Yu and Wei.

Decipher the two clues of "The Rising Sun" and "Qin Shihuang".

It was speculated that there might be a third party, that is, the Qin State.

The audience was extremely shocked.

Baby sister, are you cheating?

Do you also have a God’s perspective?
